# Wizard city homepage — revised Pages facts and preliminary operations study

Case WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84; formal screening 1. Development Advisor working draft, not an assessment, security clearance, authorization or completed host study.

## Outcome and boundaries
The resident wants an original wizard-city homepage describing management by Repository City, linking to the plugin and city repository, and GitHub Pages enablement, publication and live verification after applicable authorization. Registered scope is city-homepage at docs. Candidate: static homepage and necessary local assets without an assumed build dependency. A generated site adds dependencies and maintenance; no change avoids exposure but misses the outcome. Host compatibility, cost and reversibility remain unknown. No workflow, domain, source, outside-docs change or permission increase is assumed.

The chosen destinations are https://github.com/WebeWizard/webe-city and https://github.com/justin-leis/webe-opolis. Revised specification ART-09f8da08-dd7c-42c4-8f2d-40fd9d9832c0 and drawing ART-11b8b0ee-97ea-4789-baf4-b57b926ec28d describe the interface and context; the drawing predates the recorded link choices. Local report ART-07ffaa4d-9f6e-4543-9da0-eb1f2984b622 found no local docs tree or tracked docs/.github paths at its observation time, not remote absence.

## Resident-reported read-only GitHub evidence
Reported directly by the resident in this interaction; source observation date and time unknown. The resident reports GET repos/justin-leis/webe-opolis returned visibility public, default_branch main, has_pages false, and current token permission fields admin, maintain, pull, push and triage true. The resident reports GET repos/justin-leis/webe-opolis/pages returned HTTP 404 Not Found. Do not infer the Pages source, URL or eligibility from the 404. The resident reports GET repos/WebeWizard/webe-city succeeded and reported that repository public at https://github.com/WebeWizard/webe-city. The resident reports no settings changed. These are attributed reports, not independently executed or authenticated findings; permission fields are not permission increases, authority to act, or security clearance. No token or raw response is retained.

The earlier anonymous curl attempt in ART-242e1068-908c-46c1-ba9d-c59d756eee06 failed locally before HTTP. A successful repository API response does not establish anonymous browser reachability, ownership, link safety or future availability. It does not verify a published homepage.

## Remaining Pages facts
Current source and settings, existing publication and address if any, host eligibility and restrictions, exact target and served files, dependencies, effective least-privilege requirements, and any outside-docs changes remain unknown. Obtain permitted read-only evidence before proposing a mechanism; do not infer one from main, has_pages or the 404. The external host is not presumed city-owned.

## Planning scenarios and operations
Unintended exposure: identify the actual serving source, enumerate and review files and dependencies for restricted material before release. Incorrect, broken or inaccessible content: check both selected destinations, semantic content, keyboard operation, contrast and narrow/wide layouts before publication. Stale or failed release: record the intended revision, stop further release, preserve evidence and notify an established operator; restoration or unpublishing must use an evidenced method and separate authority. Excessive access or scope drift: establish the actual mechanism and minimum necessary access, pause and refer permission or outside-docs changes for review. Maintenance burden: establish an accountable operator, coverage, notification and escalation route, capacity and any real costs; unknown cost is not zero.

These are proposed controls, not evidence that they exist. Operator, coverage, notification, served files, host-specific recovery, capacity, cost and residual risk remain unresolved. Do not rate residual risk or claim feasible rollback from current evidence. No monitoring, notification, recovery, runtime, performance, accessibility, compatibility, security or live-publication test was performed.

## Verification and authority
After applicable delivery authorization, record revision, methods and actual results for content, links, responsiveness, accessibility and exposed-file checks. Only after separate resident authorization for applicable reserved actions and publication at a confirmed address, record address, time, evidence and actual reachability, content and both link results. Stop on failure or scope drift. Independent Inspector review and resident final acceptance remain separate. Pages enablement, deployment, publication, security or permission changes and expenditure are resident-reserved. No delivery or publication is authorized here.
